subject: "summary(fit, standardized=TRUE)" doesn't get your std estimates

messages.author: 875e6a639b728ab1
messages.subject: "summary(fit, standardized=TRUE)" doesn't get your std estimates
parts:
Hi,

I found "summary(fit, standardized=TRUE)" doesn't get your std estimates.
This is true in many tutorials, e.g., https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/sem.html.
 
Is this a bug?

Xin

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: "summary(fit, standardized=TRUE)" doesn't get your std estimates
parts: I found "summary(fit, standardized=TRUE)" doesn't get your std estimates.

This is true in many tutorials, e.g., https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/sem.html.
 
Is this a bug?

I just ran the syntax on that tutorial page, and I found the standardized ("std.lv" and "std.all") solutions in the far-right columns, just like the tutorial shows.  Are you looking in the right place?  FYI, when (additionally) requesting the standardized solution, you still get the unstandardized estimates in the "Est" column.
